summary:
[TO JAMIS------ 1  


Guess what! I’ve got art old lady! Photo enclosed of the two of us, Tessa and me. But I still love you, Jamis, and I’m still coming back to Canada soon, only I’ll be bringing Tessa with me. I’ve told her a lot about you and she likes you already. She writes science fiction and talks all the time like you, smoking the time, too, like you. And she has black hair like you, only she’s not hip; in fact she’s old fashioned and proper, except that we’re living together and like that. I took her to the LA. Con (the world science fiction convention) at the end of August; we had a really nice hotel room, spent a lot of money—I was on a panel and did very well they tell me (I talked about the phone company taking over the world). I’ve been exceptionally active s-f-wise, Jamis, lecturing at classes. Two weeks ago on Friday I was on KPFK FM live (Los Angeles) for three hours. With Normal Spinrad. We had ten phone lines bringing in calls which were piped onto the air. A big-time production with almost no breaks, not a trippy light dj type program but very heavy. Mostly we discussed fascism in science fic­ tion. Norman is a close, dear, old friend of mine; I asked that he be on with me. I took Linda and Tessa along with me and put Linda on the air a few seconds, but she screwed up and had nothing to say. Remember how good you were on CKLG? You really had it all together. Linda didn’t. 

We all had lunch with Ted Sturgeon the other day. My Paris editor from Editions Opt...
